title.zh: 晶圆与膜层：每层材料都有任务
title.en: Wafers and films: every material layer has a role

subtitle.en: From silicon to dielectric, conductor, barrier and passivation

body.zh: Passivation；Low-k /ILD；Metal Interconnect；Barrier/Liner；Contact / Via；SiN / Etch Stop或Spacer；SiO₂或High-k介质；掺杂区 / Active；Si衬底
body.en: Passivation Low-k / ILD Metal interconnect Barrier / liner Contact / via SiN / etch stop or spacer SiO₂ or high-k dielectric Doped region / active Si substrate

body.zh: 示意膜层，实际堆栈随产品变化
body.en: Schematic films; actual stacks vary by product

body.zh: 阅读堆栈的五步法；1；识别衬底
body.en: Five steps for reading a stack 1 Identify the substrate

body.zh: 2；读取Film Stack
body.en: 2 Read the film stack

body.zh: 3；判断每层功能
body.en: 3 Determine each layer’s function

body.zh: 4；确认Mask/；Stop Layer
body.en: 4 Confirm mask / stop layer

body.zh: 5；选择工艺并；验证界面
body.en: 5 Select the process and verify interfaces

body.zh: 1.四个材料指标；膜厚与成分；界面质量；应力；表面状态
body.en: 1. Four material metrics Thickness and composition Interface quality Stress Surface condition

body.zh: 2. 材料决定后续工艺；Dielectric；Deposition/；Etch / CMP
body.en: 2. Materials determine later processes Dielectric Deposition / Etch / CMP

body.zh: Conductor；Resistance/；Barrier / Corrosion
body.en: Conductor Resistance / Barrier / corrosion

body.zh: Low-k；Plasma Damage /；Mechanical Risk
body.en: Low-k Plasma damage / mechanical risk

body.zh: Barrier；Diffusion Blocking/；Added Resistance
body.en: Barrier Diffusion blocking / added resistance

body.zh: 3. 耦合权衡；阻挡能力 ↑；可能使电阻 ↑；；低介电常数材料；可能更易受；Plasma和机械作用；损伤。
body.en: 3. Coupled trade-offs Stronger blocking ↑ may raise resistance ↑; low-permittivity materials may be more vulnerable to plasma and mechanical damage

body.zh: 4. 常见失效；分层；界面污染；Void；应力裂纹；扩散失效
body.en: 4. Common failures Delamination Interface contamination Void Stress cracks Diffusion failure

body.zh: 量测反馈：膜厚 / 成分 / Sheet Resistance / 截面 / 表面分析；椭偏仪（Ellipsometry）；膜厚 / 折射率
body.en: Metrology feedback: thickness / composition / sheet resistance / cross section / surface analysis Ellipsometry Thickness / refractive index

body.zh: 成分分析（XPS / SIMS）；结合能/深度
body.en: Composition analysis (XPS / SIMS) Binding energy / depth

body.zh: 四探针（Sheet R）；片电阻
body.en: Four-point probe (sheet R) Sheet resistance

body.zh: 截面分析（TEM / STEM）；界面 /膜层结构
body.en: Cross-sectional analysis (TEM / STEM) Interfaces / film structure

body.zh: 表面分析（AFM/ SEM）；粗糙度 / 缺陷
body.en: Surface analysis (AFM / SEM) Roughness / defects

body.zh: 结果回馈：优化材料选择与工艺条件
body.en: Feedback: optimize material selection and process conditions

body.zh: 影响：；接触电阻；电容；漏电；附着力；可靠性
body.en: Impact: Contact resistance Capacitance Leakage Adhesion Reliability

body.zh: 材料名称相同，也可能因沉积方法、成分与后处理不同而表现不同。
body.en: The same material name may behave differently with deposition method, composition and post-treatment
